description: This file contains functions for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date and time data within the Git version control system. It includes implementations for converting between timestamp formats, parsing date strings in various formats, and displaying dates in different styles.

methods.name: tm_to_time_t
methods.description: Converts a struct tm to a time_t value without normalizing weekday and yearday.

methods.name: show_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string based on the specified mode.

methods.name: date_mode_from_type
methods.description: Creates a date_mode struct from a date_mode_type enum.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a timestamp and formats it according to the specified mode.

methods.name: parse_expiry_date
methods.description: Parses a string representing an expiry date into a timestamp.

methods.name: parse_date_basic
methods.description: Parses a date string in various formats into a timestamp and offset.

methods.name: parse_date_format
methods.description: Parses a date format string into a date_mode struct.

methods.name: date_mode_release
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a date_mode struct.

methods.name: datestamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string representing the current date and time.
